proves.claim: With next.returnedFirst on, the coordinator resume carries needsJudgement from the store reader and prints one line per entry.

cli.io-commands-resume.coordinator-needs.why: Without it the coordinator cannot see which items wait on a judgement from the resume card.

proves.claim: A builder seat card, and the coordinator card with next.returnedFirst off or unset, carry no needsJudgement and print today's lines.

cli.io-commands-resume.needs-judgement-c.why: Without it every seat card would grow a coordinator-only list.
